geometry: 32 by 32 viewBox; dark green rounded square surrounding a lighter green inset, with a single white angular house-shaped emblem and open lower center. The source alpha bounds are approximately x=2..29 and y=2..29. The SVG was rendered at native size and 8x, and the enlarged rendering was visually inspected.
limitations: The original has notably soft raster edges and color transitions; the vector uses simplified flat fills and deliberate straight edges, so its rendered edges can appear sharper.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
